title: jService Clue
description: A Jeopardy! clue (question + answer pair) sourced from jArchive and served by jService.

answer.description: The Jeopardy 'answer' (the clue read by the host).

question.description: The Jeopardy 'question' (the response a contestant must give).

value.description: Dollar value of the clue. Null for Final Jeopardy clues.

category_id.description: Foreign key to the parent category.

game_id.description: Foreign key to the originating Jeopardy! game.

invalid_count.description: How many users have flagged this clue as invalid via POST /api/invalid.
